senses.gloss: मुल् मुल् = rt. मूल्, q. v.

मूल् मूल् (more properly to be regarded
as a Nom. fr. मूल below), cl. 1. P.
मूलति (according to Vopa-deva also A. -ते), मु-
मूल, मूलितुम्, to be rooted or firm, stand fast,
take or strike root: Caus. मूलयति (according to
Vopa-deva also मोलयति), मूलयितुम्, Aor. अमू-
मुलत्, to plant, transplant; to grow, sprout, shoot,
germinate.

मुलालिन् मुलालिन्, ई, m. or मुलाली, f., Ved.
(probably) a species of edible lotus.

मूल, अम्, n. a root (literally and metaphorically);
the root of any plant or tree, (मूलं कृ, to take or
strike root); the root of Arum Campanulatum; the
root of long pepper and of Costus Speciosus or Ara-
bicus; basis, groundwork, beginning, origin, com-
mencement, cause, (मूलाद् आरभ्य, having com-
menced at the beginning); the bottom of anything,
foot, (शैलस्य मूलम्, the foot of a mountain);
basis, lower part, lower end, (वीणाया मूलम्, the
lower end of a lute which rests against the body of
a player); the end or juncture of anything by which
it is joined to anything else [cf. बाहु-म्˚, कर्ण-
म्˚]; outermost edge or border; original, original
text of any work (as distinguished from the scholia
or commentary); an old or hereditary servant or
dependant, an aboriginal native or inhabitant; ori-
ginal property, capital, principal, stock; a chief or
capital city; square root; the twenty-fourth or,
according to some, seventeenth or nineteenth lunar
asterism containing eleven stars, (in this sense अस्,
अम्, m. n.; cf. नक्षत्र); immediate neigh-
bourhood or proximity; a copse, thicket; a vendor
not a true owner, (according to Kullūka on Manu
VIII. 202. मूलम् = अ-स्वामी विक्रेता); a particular
position of the fingers [cf. मूल-बन्ध]; (अस्),
m. an epithet of Sadā-śiva; (आ), f. Asparagus Race-
mosus; the asterism Mūla; (ई), f. a species of small
house-lizard; (अस्, आ, अम्), original, first; own,
proper, peculiar, (in Manu VII. 184. मूल is said
to mean a king's own territory.)
—मूल-कर्मन्,
अ, n. ‘root-machination,’ magical employment of
roots, magic; [cf. मूली-कर्मन्, मूल-कृत्.]
—मूल-कार, अस्, m. the author of an original
work.
—मूल-कारण, अम्, n. first or original
cause.
—मूल-कारिका, f. a fire-place, furnace, oven.
—मूल-कृच्छ्र, अस्, अम्, m. n. ‘root-austerity,’
a kind of penance, living solely on roots.
—मूल-
कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. preparing roots for magical uses.
—मूल-केशर, अस्, m. a citron.
—मूल-खा-
नक, अस्, m. ‘root-digger,’ one who digs for roots,
a collector of roots.
—मूल-गुण, अस्, m. ‘root-
multiplier,’ the coefficient of a root (in algebra).
—मूलगुण-जाति, इस्, f. assimilation and reduction
of the root's coefficient with a fraction.
—मूल-
ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. an original text; an epithet of
the very words uttered by Śākya-muni.
—मूल-
च्छेद, अस्, m. ‘root-cutting,’ cutting away the
roots, cutting up by the roots, uprooting.
—मूल-ज,
अस्, आ, अम्, ‘root-born,’ growing from roots, pro-
[]
duced from a root, radical; formed at the roots of
trees (as an ant-hill); (अस्), m. a plant growing
from a root (as a lotus); (अम्), n. green ginger.
—मूल-जाति, इस्, f. chief or principal origin; = मू-
लगुण-जाति, col. 2.
—मूल-तस्, ind. from the root,
on the root, on the lower side (Ved.), (आ मूलतस्,
from the root upwards, from the beginning.)
—मू-
ल-त्रिकोण, अम्, n. epithet of the third astrological
house.
—मूल-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of
a root, the being a root, the having a foundation or
source in anything, (मूलत्वात् प्रजानां राजा
स्कन्धः, the king is the stem through his subjects
being the root; वेद-मूलत्व, the statement that
the Veda is the original source of all knowledge;
शास्त्र-मूलत्व, the being founded upon the Śās-
tras.)
—मूल-देव, अस्, m. = मूर-देव, an epithet
of Kaṃsa [cf. मूल-भद्र]; N. of the murderer
of Su-mitra the son of Agni-mitra; of an author; of
a preceptor.
—मूल-द्रव्य, अम्, n. original pro-
perty, capital, principal, stock; [cf. मूल-धन.]
—मूल-द्वार, अम्, n., Ved. principal door.
—मू-
ल-द्वारवती, f. the original or ancient Dvāra-vatī,
the older part of that city; [cf. लघु-द्वारवती,
मूल-नगर.]
—मूल-धन, अम्, n. original
property, capital.
—मूल-धातु, उस्, m. lymph.
—मूल-नगर, अम्, n. old town, (opposed to the
suburbs or शाखा-नगर.)
—मूल-नाश or मूल-
नाशक, अस्, m. a proper N.
—मूल-निकृन्तन,
अस्, ई, अम्, cutting away the roots, utterly destroying,
destroying root and branch.
—मूल-पर्णी, f. a
species of plant (= मण्डूक-पर्णी).
—मूल-पाक,
अस्, m., see Pāṇ. VII. 3, 53.
—मूल-पुरुष, अस्,
m. the male representative of a family, the last
male of a race.
—मूल-पुलिश-सिद्धान्त, अस्,
m. the original Siddhānta of Puliśa.
—मूल-पुष्-
कर, अम्, n. = पुष्कर-मूल, q. v.
—मूल-पोती,
f. a species of culinary plant (= पोतिका).
—मूल-
प्रकृति, इस्, f. (in phil.) the original root or germ
out of which matter or all apparent forms are evolved,
the primary cause or ‘originant;’ (अयस्), f. pl. the
four principal sovereigns to be considered in time of
war (viz. the Vi-jigīṣu, Ari, Madhyama, and Ud-
āsīna; cf. प्र-कृति, शाखा-प्रकृति).
—मूल-
प्रणिहित, अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps) placed under the
surveillance or brought under the notice of old
(thieves employed as spies; according to Kullūka on
Manu IX. 269 = राज-नियुक्त-पुराण-चौर-
वर्गे सावधान-भूताः).
—मूल-फल-द, अस्,
m. the Jaka or bread-fruit tree.
—मूल-फलाशन
(˚ल-अश्˚), अम्, n. feeding on roots and fruits.
—मूल-
बणिग्-धन, अम्, n. a merchant's original property
or capital.
—मूल-बन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably)
having roots, deep-rooted; (अस्), m. a particular po-
sition of the fingers.
—मूल-बर्हण, अस्, ई, अम्,
Ved. tearing up by the roots, uprooting; (ई, अम्),
f. n. the Nakṣatra Mūla; (अम्), n. the act of
uprooting.
—मूल-भद्र, अस्, m. an epithet of
Kaṃsa, the uncle of Kṛṣṇa; [cf. मूल-देव.]
—मूल-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, springing or growing
from roots.
—मूल-भार, अस्, m. a load of roots.
—मूल-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become the root or
original.
—मूल-भृत्य, अस्, m. an old or here-
ditary servant, one whose father, grandfather, &c.
were servants before him, (opposed to आ-गन्तु.)
—मूल-मन्त्र, अस्, m. an original or funda-
mental text; an epithet of a particular sacred text.
—मूल-माधव, N. of a place.
—मूलमा-
धव-तीथ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.
—मूल-मित्र, अस्, m. a proper N.
—मूल-रस,
अस्, m. Sanseviera Zeylanica.
—मूल-राज, अस्, m.,
N. of a king.
—मूल-रामायण, अम्, n. the ori-
ginal Rāmāyaṇa, i. e. Vālmīki's Rāmāyaṇa.
—मूल-
वचन, अम्, n. ‘primary word,’ an original text.
—मूल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing edible roots;
(perhaps) practising magic with roots.
—मूल-वाप,
अस्, m. one who plants roots.
—मूल-वारिन्, ई, m. a
proper N.
—मूल-वित्त, अम्, n. ‘original property,’
capital, principal.
—मूल-विद्या, f. ‘principal science,’
epithet of a particular Mantra (= द्वादशाक्षर,
q. v.).
—मूल-विनाशन, अम्, n. radical or entire
destruction.
—मूल-विभुज, अस्, आ, अम्, bending
[]
down roots; (अस्), m. a chariot.
—मूल-विरेचन,
अम्, n. a purgative prepared from roots.
—मूल-
व्यसन-वृत्ति, इस्, f. the hereditary occupation of
executing criminals (Manu X. 38).
—मूल-व्रतिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, living exclusively on roots.
—मूल-शकुन,
अस्, m. (in augury) the first bird.
—मूल-शाकट or
मूल-शाकिन, अम्, n. a field planted with edible
roots.
—मूल-श्रीपति-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
Tīrtha.
—मूल-सङ्घ, अस्, m. a society or sect.
—मूल-सर्वास्तिवाद (˚व-अस्˚), आस्, m. pl., N. of
a Buddhist school.
—मूल-साधन, अम्, n. a chief
instrument, principal expedient.
—मूल-सूत्र, अम्,
n. a principal Sūtra.
—मूल-स्थल, अम्, n., N. of
a place.
—मूल-स्थान, अम्, n. principal place;
foundation, base; the air, atmosphere; God; Mool-
tan; (ई), f. an epithet of Gaurī.
—मूलस्थान-
तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha (= भास्कर).
—मूल-स्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, existing from the begin-
ning; (ई), m. an epithet of Śiva.
—मूल-स्रोतस्, अस्, n.
the fountain-head of a river, principal current.
—मूल-
हर, अस्, आ, अम्, taking away the roots of anything,
uprooting, utterly destroying, eradicating.
—मूल-
हर-त्व, अम्, n. the state of plucking up by the
roots, eradicating, utter ruin.
—मूलाधार (˚ल-
आध्˚), अम्, n., scil. चक्र, epithet of a mystical
circle situated above the generative organs; (accord-
ing to a Scholiast) the navel.
—मूलाभ (˚ल-आभ्˚),
अम्, n. a radish.
—मूलाभिधर्म-शास्त्र (˚ल-
अभ्˚), अम्, n. the original Abhidharma-śāstra
—मू-
लायतन (˚ल-आय्˚), अम्, n. an original residence.
—मूलाविद्या-विनाशक (˚ल-अव्˚), अस्, इका, अम्,
(probably) destroying ignorance at its roots, eradi-
cating ignorance.
—मूलाशिन् (˚ल-आश्˚), ई, इनी, इ,
‘root-eating,’ living upon roots.
—मूलाह्वा (˚ल-
आह्˚), अम्, n. a radish.
—मूली-कर्मन्, अ, n. = मूल-
कर्मन्, q. v.
—मूली-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become a
root, become a source or origin.
—मूलोच्छेद (˚ल-
उच्˚), अस्, m. cutting up the roots, utter destruction.
—मूलोत्खात (˚ल-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, dug up by
the roots, utterly destroyed; (अम्), n. digging up
roots.
—मूलोत्पाटन (˚ल-उत्˚), अम्, n. the digging
up of roots.
—मूलोत्पाटन-जीविन्, ई, m. one who
lives by digging for roots (= मूल-खानक).
—मू-
लौषधि (˚ल-ओष्˚), इस्, f. a species of plant.

मूलक, अस्, इका, अम्, (at the end of comps.)
having roots, rooted in, springing from; born under
the constellation Mūla; (अस्, अम्), m. n. an esculent
root; a radish [cf. चाणक्य-म्˚, नेपाल-म्˚]; a
sort of yam; (अस्), m. a kind of vegetable poison;
N. of a prince, a son of Aśmaka; (इका), f. a root.
—मूलक-पण, अस्, m. a handful or bunch of
radishes, &c. (for sale).
—मूलक-पर्णी, f. Moringa
Pterygosperma.
—मूलक-पोतिका, f. a radish.
—मू-
लक-मूला, f. the plant Lipeocercis Serrata.

मूलस, अस्, आ, अम्, see Gaṇa Tṛṇādi to Pāṇ.
IV. 2, 80.

मूलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, living on roots; radical,
original; primary, principal; (अस्), m. an ascetic,
devotee; (आ), f. a multitude or collection of roots.
—मूलिकार्थ (˚क-अर्˚), अस्, m. a radical fact;
[cf. योग.]

मूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a root or stock or origin,
&c.; (ई), m. a tree.

मूलेर, अस्, m. a king; Indian spikenard, Nar-
dostachys Jatamansi (= जटा-मांसी, जटा).

मूल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being at the root; to be torn
up by the roots, to be eradicated; to be bought
for a price, to be bought, purchasable; (अम्), n. ori-
ginal value; price, worth, value, a sum of money
given as payment (e. g. दातुम् मूल्येन, to part
with for a certain price, sell; दत्त्वा किञ्चिन् मूल्-
येन, having given something in payment; मूल्-
येन गृहीत, bought for a price); wages, salary,
payment for service rendered; earnings, gain; =
मूल, capital, principal; an article purchased.
—मू-
ल्य-करण, अम्, n. making the worth or value of
anything, turning into money.
—मूल्य-विवर्जित,
अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of price, priceless, invaluable.

मूलाट मूलाट, मूलाटी, see Gaṇa Gaurādi
to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 41.
